headline: Durga Puja: Shops and malls can stay open until 10pm
summary: The government has extended shopping hours by two hours to facilitate Puja shopping across Bangladesh until October 22.
details: The government has announced that shopping malls, markets, and shops across Bangladesh can remain open for an additional two hours ahead of Durga Puja.
According to the Power Division, businesses are now permitted to operate from 11am to 10pm until October 22. The previous schedule of 11am to 8pm will return on October 23.
The Power Division has notified all city corporation mayors, divisional commissioners, deputy commissioners, and shop owners' associations in Dhaka and across the country.
Power distribution authorities, including the Bangladesh Power Development Board and DESCO, have also been informed of the extended hours.
The government had previously reduced shop hours to 8pm in August to save electricity and improve power management amid an ongoing energy crisis.
This year, shopping hours have been changed multiple times, including a 6pm closing time in April and extensions for Eid-ul-Azha.
caption:
More time for Puja shopping! 🛍️

Government extends shop hours until 10pm across Bangladesh.

The government has announced that shopping malls, markets, and shops across Bangladesh can remain open for an additional two hours ahead of Durga Puja.

According to the Power Division, businesses are now permitted to operate from 11am to 10pm until October 22. The previous schedule of 11am to 8pm will return on October 23.

The Power Division has notified all city corporation mayors, divisional commissioners, deputy commissioners, and shop owners' associations in Dhaka and across the country.

Power distribution authorities, including the Bangladesh Power Development Board and DESCO, have also been informed of the extended hours.

The government had previously reduced shop hours to 8pm in August to save electricity and improve power management amid an ongoing energy crisis.

This year, shopping hours have been changed multiple times, including a 6pm closing time in April and extensions for Eid-ul-Azha.

headline_marked: Two [[Indian nationals shot in BSF firing]] at Kurigram border
headline: Two Indian nationals shot in BSF firing at Kurigram border
summary: The incident occurred at the Bangladesh-India border in Kurigram, involving the Border Security Force of India.
details: Two Indian nationals were shot during a firing incident involving the Border Security Force (BSF) at the Kurigram border.
The shooting took place at the international border between Bangladesh and India in the Kurigram district.
The BSF opened fire, resulting in two individuals from India being injured.
Further details regarding the motive or circumstances leading to the firing are currently being investigated.
